newsitem.title: USA: President exercises option on Pa. land.
newsitem.headline: President exercises option on Pa. land.

text.p: President Casinos Inc said it exercised an option for January 1, 1997 through December 31, 1997 allowing it to secure lease rights to 18 acres of riverfront property in the Penn's Landing area of Philadelphia.
The company said it also has the right to secure lease rights to the property for four more six-month option periods beginning January 1, 1998.

"This property is located in close proximity to downtown Philadelphia and all major highways. If gaming is approved in Pennsylvania, this site would be a premier location for two riverboat casino operations," the company said.
